requirements: R1: Editor can draft a new epidemiological material or protocol

slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 0 schema migration failures during deployment

epics.title: System Data Protection and Recovery
epics.jtbd: When a critical failure occurs, I want to restore the knowledge base from a verified backup, so that epidemiological data is protected from permanent loss.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) is under 2 hours with 100% data integrity
requirements: R1: The system performs automated daily backups of all knowledge base data
R2: A tested and verified procedure exists to restore the system from a backup
R3: The system alerts administrators on backup failure

slices.acceptanceCriteria:

Given a failed backup job, When it terminates with an error, Then an alert is dispatched to administrators.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% success rate for daily automated backup runs over a 30-day window

slices.title: Verify data restore procedure

slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a recent system backup, When the restore procedure is executed in a staging environment, Then the system recovers to the exact state of the snapshot without data corruption.
Given the restored system, When verified, Then all previously published materials remain fully accessible.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 0 manual steps required beyond the documented restore script

epics.title: Editor Account Recovery

R2: Editor can securely set a new password using the time-limited link

slices.title: Define API contract for account recovery

slices.title: Implement account recovery backend logic

slices.title: Verify account recovery flow
